title: Bloom & Breeze – Fashion in the Fields 🌸🌿
content:
🌸✨ There’s something magical about watching clothes dance in the breeze. For this piece, I wanted to capture that in-between moment – when garments aren’t on the runway yet, but are already alive. Each piece was digitally crafted in CLO3D, then placed in a sunny daisy field where nature takes over as the ultimate stylist.  
It’s a reminder that fashion doesn’t just live on bodies – it lives in the air, in the light, and in the stories we imagine while it moves.

![0d5a93d6a9f8486b8d6eeb6d0864b4ed](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/1957d8a7ebe6455fa93f576e3a57dbb1/images/0d5a93d6a9f8486b8d6eeb6d0864b4ed10569.png)![26e83f34c6a64e5899eec1a7c1366e10](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/1957d8a7ebe6455fa93f576e3a57dbb1/images/26e83f34c6a64e5899eec1a7c1366e1010149.png)![4795f85220924c828e137d39a6f2c6eb](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/1957d8a7ebe6455fa93f576e3a57dbb1/images/4795f85220924c828e137d39a6f2c6eb20048.png)![08b0cd9b135b496d9d4950f815d40c13](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/1957d8a7ebe6455fa93f576e3a57dbb1/images/08b0cd9b135b496d9d4950f815d40c1320175.png)![9746f3813d9c47519cb8bb285647c5e0](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/1957d8a7ebe6455fa93f576e3a57dbb1/images/9746f3813d9c47519cb8bb285647c5e020594.png)
content_description: Experience the enchanting interplay of fashion and nature as garments come to life in a sunny daisy field, celebrating the artistry of movement before they grace the runway.

title: 3d rendered  looks different, when using transparent image
content:
hi ,

CLO giving this type of results when using opacity map. Left side is 3d view window and right side is 3d rendered window, looks different in both the windows.. I am using a transparent image in opacity map. I also used (tried) online PBR textures but all gives different in folding side. although when i am not using transparent map is goes well. 

Please suggest.![2781d73735174d3fba0ee87365749933](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/c04f3d42ceba4e49aa1f9aadce561214/images/2781d73735174d3fba0ee87365749933image.png)


### Community Post Comments:


Comment 2: please help on this my .png files having transparency, not properly shown in .glb file whereas in 3d rendered image it is perfectly shown.
Reply 1: Where are you viewing this GLB file? Does it look fine when imported into CLO? Please note that we do not receive notifications about a new reply unless it is under one of the comments we already left, therefore we are unlikely to catch the reply swiftly.

Comment 3: I DID THAT for opacity map but transparent png files gives different result in .glb files whereas it is perfect in 3d rendered image

Comment 4: Hi Melody,Please look at the attached screenshot of opacity map.Yes, Quality render have the same results.
Reply 1: The image looks completely white or at least very low contrast and light in this dimension, only black parts will become transparent. Please check out this tutorial: https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/c04f3d42ceba4e49aa1f9aadce561214

Comment 5: Hi Melody,In left side image the result comes with back image, if i am using .png with transparency.yes png format have some issues. Quality render have same results.
Reply 1: Is the image you're using for the opacity map a black and white image? Anything that is black will become transparent. Could you share a screenshot of the Property Editor, please?

Comment 6: Hi, sorry, I am a bit lost here. What are you trying to achieve and what looks wrong about the outcome? The 3D window is not the best measure of the output, but always the render window. E.g. there is an issue with certain PNGs that have an alpha layer, even if there is no active transparency in the image itself. How does the 3D window look when you turn on Quality Render?
content_description: This webpage aims to seek solutions and suggestions for resolving discrepancies between 3D views and rendered outputs when using opacity maps in CLO software.
